selectionDecisions: Operations chosen from live schema: native MCP prepare/validate/attack/status/stop, exact as-user seed and existing baseline/report/runtime helpers. Common product registry lacks ByteMe/full body capabilities; a ByteMe-only adapter was used, preserving shared gates.

SQL injection for numeric/enum/query boundaries and textual JSON processing, reflected XSS for textual JSON, CRLF for relevant path/query/header handling. Source stores imageUrl without server fetch; no SSRF/OS/file/XML sink found in assigned protected handlers.
Every required text mutation has an immediate independent API GET before the next native mutation. ACK and final snapshots cannot supply this unit.
Checkout cart is explicitly populated with one owned test item before each native request; fixture traffic is counted separately.
Separate CONFIRMED fixtures for status body and selector questions are allocated before traffic. Numeric parser questions exclude later state-conflict responses from qualifying observations.

Rule 40012 uses LOW alert threshold to exercise PUT JSON reflection. LOW strength is the finite workload size; native alert risk/confidence remain unchanged. CRLF retains query/header/path canary questions; only changed application requests qualify. A canary rejected by a typed parser is a boundary result, not a claim that CR/LF reached a response-header sink.

operations.technique: direct independent API GET immediately after successful mutation and before next native request
operations.interpretation: Read count includes baselines and unchanged native controls. The 12 text-field obligations use only changed target values with their own matched readbacks.

alertSummary.counting: Groups by native plugin/name/risk; instances are unique current-session native API alert IDs, read to total count. JSON report samples are separately counted.

operationalIssues.issue: Transient host disk reserve check blocked the next unsent campaign before baseline/start.
operationalIssues.diagnosis: Transient host free-space dipped 272KiB below unchanged 2GiB reserve before the next campaign baseline/start. Native state and journal show no unsent campaign attempt.
operationalIssues.action: Reconciled native terminal state and journal, remeasured resources above the original gate, then continued only unsent campaigns. No data deletion or cap/reserve change.

limitations: Completion concerns discovered protected API/input responsibilities and selected techniques; it is not proof of product safety or exhaustive payload/state/rule coverage.
Numeric/enum mutations often end at authenticated parser/validation boundaries. No claim that those payloads reached database query/transition execution.
Guard denies foreign numeric IDs/references, undeclared paths/shapes, out-of-origin traffic and mismatched identity. Denied probes receive no application coverage credit.

State-changing original requests may return 404/409 after the successful positive baseline. Actual statuses retained; fresh status-selector fixture and replenished checkout carts prevent unintentional blockers in the selected processing questions.
No browser rendering, stored/DOM XSS exploit, full token expiry/revoke lifecycle or cross-owner BOLA matrix was requested or claimed.
Exact runtime image-to-source commit attestation is unavailable; Compose origin, matching runtime OpenAPI and current role behavior verified.
Owned orders retained CANCELLED and foods INACTIVE; no hard-delete API. CUSTOMER reused from the latest anonymous run remains.

target.retained: Order records retained CANCELLED; food records retained INACTIVE. No hard-delete/account deletion API exists. Reused prior CUSTOMER; no new accounts created.

scanner.privateRetention: Working root access restricted to owner after owned scanner containers were removed; raw credentials retained private.

securityConclusion: Native classifications retained; selected input handling and processing observations do not certify absence of vulnerabilities.

reportReadback.interpretation: The native report repeats identical origin site entries in this run. Raw sample rows include that repetition and report sampling; occurrence totals use current native API IDs, not report rows.

fixturePlanning.basis: Selected finite LOW native workloads; immediate readbacks and checkout replenishment are separate traffic.
fixturePlanning.stateDependentProcessing: Text create/update requires persistence; numeric/enum parser rejection answers only its boundary question. 404/409 fixture conflict does not supply that observation.
